August

August 12

Grok 4.6

Grok 4.6, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API. It has a 500k context window, text and image inputs with text-only output. See the Grok 4.6 overview and the announcement.

August 11

Adjustable VAD threshold

Speech to Text now accepts a vad_threshold parameter.
